description.value: Galini Greek Kouzina is a family-run sit-down Greek restaurant on Fraser Highway in Surrey, rooted in the culinary traditions of Epirus, Greece and open since 2005. The menu spans a full mezedes program — calamari, saganaki flambé, spanakopita, and a signature pulled lamb poutine — through to souvlaki and grilled steaks. The two-storey building also houses event ballrooms used for wedding receptions and catering, giving the restaurant a notably larger footprint than a typical neighbourhood Greek spot.

Takeout is confirmed via explicit DoorDash, SkipTheDishes, and Uber Eats listings plus a 'Pickup' prompt; vegetarian and GF options are confirmed via multiple menu items and an explicit 'Gluten-free, dairy-free, trans-fat free' note on the house salad dressing. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, charging, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
